scope: Independent numerical and end-to-end validation using synthetic data only. None of the numbers in this file are study results.
independent_reference_method: Constructed synthetic age/diagnosis/sex/PCCL count records, grouped them independently of build_cells, and used exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction) for pooled risks, binomial variances and matched crude ratios. Normal/delta intervals were independently evaluated with z=1.959963984540054.

synthetic_fixture.workbook_format: Info worksheets with selection metadata and integer-recoverable age, sex and PCCL distributions
features: Unequal supported strata with different risks and group allocations
Sex and PCCL partitions deliberately produce different retained populations
Children in the original reference exports, excluded from adult query exports

checks_passed: Joint-cell reconstruction matches independently grouped synthetic records
Other principal diagnoses are reconstructed separately within total, dysphagia, total deaths and dysphagia deaths
Pooled standardized risks, RR, risk difference and normal/delta intervals match independent calculations within 1e-12
Crude comparison uses exactly the retained common-support population
Coverage is correct separately for total, dysphagia and comparator populations
Supported zero-event strata are retained
Unsupported strata are excluded using denominators only
No common-support cells returns not_estimable
Zero standardized dysphagia risk returns RR zero and no log-RR interval
Negative other-diagnosis residual is rejected
Dysphagia denominator exceeding total is rejected
Comparator deaths exceeding comparator population are rejected
Incomplete I63 selection is rejected
A minor in an adult age-query source is rejected
Changed native age distribution in an original reference is rejected even when the broad adult total is preserved
Original-reference minors do not enter either adult standardization
All 24 new and four original synthetic Info workbooks pass the full parsing and validation pipeline
Missing 48 new queries and eight original references yield pending status with effects_computed false
A pending status-only run creates only its status JSON
A pending normal run exits with code 2 and writes no effect estimates
An available status-only run still writes no effect estimates
A complete synthetic command-line run matches both independent reference calculations
limitations: Synthetic validation verifies implementation behavior, not the scientific validity or completeness of future study inputs.
The actual joint-query workbooks were not available and no study joint-standardization estimates were produced.
Synthetic source workbooks and output files are temporary QA material and are not included in the scientific repository package.
actual_schema_note: Observed Altersgruppe field accepted directly; original selection text preserved. This does not constitute completion of the joint analysis.
